payload_template_vars.safe_dx: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion

responses: 22-year-old male. The patient reports that the pain and swelling in his right ring finger began 2 days ago while playing football. He recalls his finger got caught in the jersey of another player, who then pulled away forcefully.

My main symptom is Progressive swelling and pain in the right ring finger. I also have Inability to flex the right ring finger at the distal interphalangeal joint when making a fist, Pain at the distal interphalangeal joint, Extended right ring finger in resting position.
Past medical history: No significant medical history. Social history: Student and active in sports, particularly football. Non-smoker and drinks alcohol socially.
Denies fever, numbness, or tingling in the affected finger. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.
